STEP 4 To purchase a PlayStation®Plus membership using the funds from this code select the membership plan of your choice, and complete the purchase. High speed (at least 5 Mbps) internet connection required. Accessible content varies by subscriber age (18+ required when streaming via PC App). Certain games may not be available to stream. Availability of Classics, Game Trials and Game Catalogue varies over time and plan. See https://www.playstation.com/Plus for details and updates on PS Plus offerings. PlayStation Plus is an ongoing subscription subject to a recurring subscription fee taken automatically (at the then-current PS Store price) at the frequency you choose at purchase until cancellation.
